source_policy: Primary linked pages inspected as of forecast vintage; sources, survey percentages and platform claims retain population and causal limitations.

sources.title: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026 — AI tool usage
sources.limitation: Optional multi-select question n=17,464; 65.9% assistants/agents, 26.2% automated workflows among respondents; not representative of all developers.

sources.title: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026 — methodology
sources.limitation: 30,903 valid overall responses; online promoted survey, varying optional-question denominators, not a random population sample.

sources.title: METR early-2025 AI impact on experienced OSS developers
sources.limitation: Randomized mature-OSS tasks and selected experienced developers; an early-2025 estimate cannot be generalized to later models or other tasks.

sources.title: METR changing developer-productivity experiment design
sources.limitation: Selection bias, nonparticipation, concurrent agents and imperfect time measurement make late-2025 speed estimates unreliable.

sources.title: Balancing AI tensions: effective software-development lifecycle use
sources.limitation: Association of AI adoption with throughput and instability is not a causal universal benefit/harm.

sources.title: GitHub Octoverse 2025
sources.limitation: Platform-defined AI-related repository counts and activity are not agent-authored-code prevalence or verified external reuse.

sources.title: Build 2026: Furthering Windows as the trusted platform for development

sources.title: Identity and security in Windows 365 for Agents
sources.limitation: Describes vendor-specific Entra identities, isolated stateless sessions and audit; not independent security validation.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol 2026-07-28 specification
sources.limitation: Versioned protocol spec, stateless core. Availability of the spec does not guarantee cross-implementation support or backward compatibility.

sources.title: Agent2Agent protocol
sources.limitation: Standardizes agent-to-agent communication; not a security certification or evidence that all platforms support it.

sources.title: Energy and AI (2025)
sources.limitation: Energy scenarios and datasets refer to particular energy-system boundaries; do not convert code tokens to emissions.

sources.title: Key Questions on Energy and AI (2026)
sources.limitation: Updated energy analysis, not measured footprint of this repository's tasks or any coding agent.

sources.title: SCI for AI
sources.limitation: Lifecycle carbon-intensity methodology; implementing it requires metering or transparent assumptions, actual functional units and scope.

sources.title: SLSA v1.2 specification
sources.limitation: Provenance and supply-chain assurance are distinct from user-task correctness and license compatibility.

sources.title: OSV open-source vulnerability database
sources.limitation: Covers known advisories by package/commit; no advisory does not mean no vulnerability.

sources.title: OpenSSF Scorecard
sources.limitation: Heuristic checks for security practices; aggregate score alone does not establish safety.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026

sources.title: Summary of responses on security considerations for AI agents
sources.limitation: Summary of stakeholder responses to an RFI; opinions and reported risks, not a randomized security experiment.

forecasts.leading_indicator: Share of opt-in tasks with verified agent delegation; split by complexity and model version
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: No increase in independently accepted agent-delivered tasks at controlled difficulty and cost

forecasts.leading_indicator: Independent defect, review/rework, comprehension and upgrade outcomes
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Quality and comprehension improve without growing review burdens

forecasts.leading_indicator: Third-party acceptance of same task over CLI/API/MCP; version compatibility
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Tool protocols add no reliable task benefit versus stable CLI/API

forecasts.leading_indicator: Isolated tool execution, permission checks, rollback and negative permission tests
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Secure agent execution remains niche or ordinary non-agent controls consistently suffice

forecasts.leading_indicator: Different model runtimes available, cost and independent task success under fixed specs
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Model-specific vertically integrated deployments consistently dominate

forecasts.leading_indicator: Long-running agent tasks with checkpoints, audit/recovery and real misaction rates
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Autonomy's total review, error and recovery cost exceeds its measured benefits

forecasts.leading_indicator: Task-first correctly integrated upstream component discovery across old, quiet and new sources
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Well-structured metadata does not improve safe independent reuse over current discovery tools

forecasts.leading_indicator: New releases, sustained externally accepted workflows and maintenance burden by team size
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Higher code-release volume does not improve repeat-use success or sustainability

forecasts.leading_indicator: Metered kWh and coverage per independently accepted task plus absolute workload
forecasts.disconfirming_signal: Energy telemetry remains inaccessible or intensity changes fail to improve real decisions

proposed_metrics.name: Independent first-use task success
proposed_metrics.unit: successful independent users / consenting attempted users
proposed_metrics.denominator: all consented prospective first-use attempts, including failures
proposed_metrics.evidence: versioned task + original runtime logs + evaluator record

proposed_metrics.name: All-task accepted completion
proposed_metrics.unit: independently accepted tasks / all randomized assigned tasks
proposed_metrics.denominator: all preregistered allocations incl no-reuse, refusals, abandoned and unfinished
proposed_metrics.evidence: frozen tests and blinded independent assessment; opt-in and preregistration required

proposed_metrics.name: Human and compute task cost
proposed_metrics.unit: human-active minutes and compute cost per assignment; report failures separately
proposed_metrics.evidence: time log + model version + provider token/billing where permitted

proposed_metrics.name: Verified reuse
proposed_metrics.unit: independently validated third-party integrations, by task/source stratum
proposed_metrics.denominator: all prospectively framed tasks; report unknown viable candidates separately
proposed_metrics.evidence: independent reproducible integration test, version/license/security check

proposed_metrics.name: Unauthorized agent action
proposed_metrics.unit: unsafe/unauthorized actions per observed actionable tool invocation
proposed_metrics.denominator: all logged action opportunities, including denied and failed
proposed_metrics.evidence: policy simulation and sandbox audit; no real secrets or production actions in tests

proposed_metrics.name: Maintenance and upstream burden
proposed_metrics.unit: human review/support/upgrade minutes and observed defects per unit over 30/90/180 days
proposed_metrics.denominator: all eligible accepted releases/changes and censored followups
proposed_metrics.evidence: permissioned issue/PR time accounting and reproducible regression testing

proposed_metrics.name: Lifecycle energy per accepted task
proposed_metrics.unit: kWh per independently accepted functional task (if meterable)
proposed_metrics.denominator: accepted tasks plus explicit assignment count and meter-coverage fraction
proposed_metrics.evidence: metered source, time region, hardware, power boundary, embodied/operational assumptions

prospective_study_guardrails: Do not change registered primary estimands with a strategy document.
Sample prospective tasks before search or known reuse availability.
Use independent task acceptance and human review, not self-authored agent tests.
Store true UTC timestamps, source versions and missingness.
Separate attention from actual use; avoid GitHub Trending as reuse proof.
No token-to-kWh or carbon conversion without direct metering or explicit modeled scope.
Obtain consent and source rights before human data or automated collection.
review_rule: Preserve this forecast vintage. Append separately dated quarterly forecast-vs-evidence comparisons, including contradictory and null findings.
